name: White Eight
source:
You are a wrongfully imprisoned 21-year-old man being released to a new life, which is full of tantalizing strangers and maybe even some faces from your past. Since you're still on probation and have no other options you will be living in a supervised flat-sharing community with three other former convicts.

[From [url=https://s-o-u-l-games.itch.io/white-eight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个被错误监禁的21岁男子，被释放后开始了新的生活，其中充满了诱人的陌生人，甚至可能还有一些你过去的面孔。由于你仍在缓刑期间并且没有其他选择，因此你将与其他三名前罪犯住在受监督的公寓社区中。

[来自[url=https://s-o-u-l-games.itch.io/white-eight]Itch.io[/url]]
